title: Nodes
help: Register a node, issue its private bootstrap and check its actual connection.
name: Name
runtimeHelp: These values are saved for this node and included in its bootstrap. The agent reads them at startup.
editRuntimeHelp: Saving advances the configuration revision. Download a new bootstrap and redeploy the agent for runtime changes to take effect.
configurationEffects: Certificate settings are saved for later credential lifecycle support. Existing credentials are unchanged; rotation and renewal are unavailable.
bootstrapHelp: Keep the download private: it contains this node’s server key. Extract it beside the agent and start the agent with agent.json. Xray must already be running with its local API enabled.
limits: This step registers and checks an existing agent. Core process installation, configuration editing and certificate renewal are still being implemented.

errors.node_not_ready: Agent or Xray is not ready
